title: Senior Full Stack Developer (React & Node.js)
description: You are a Senior Full Stack Developer with a strong backend focus who enjoys building scalable, cloud-native applications using TypeScript across the entire stack. While you'll contribute across both frontend and backend development, your primary focus will be designing and building robust serverless backend services while delivering modern React user experiences. You thrive working within established architectures, quickly understanding existing codebases and delivering production-ready solutions with minimal supervision. You take ownership of your work, write clean and maintainable code, and believe software quality is everyone's responsibility. You are proactive, analytical, and collaborative, enjoying close partnerships with cross-functional teams while actively contributing to Agile ceremonies and continuously improving engineering practices. You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies 5+ years of professional experience as a Full Stack Software Developer or Software Engineer. Strong experience developing production applications using TypeScript across both frontend and backend. Strong experience building modern web applications with React . Experience designing and developing RESTful APIs using OpenAPI . Experience implementing schema validation using Zod or similar libraries. Experience building serverless applications using AWS Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB . Strong understanding of DynamoDB Single-Table Design and access-pattern modeling. Experience provisioning infrastructure using AWS CDK or similar Infrastructure as Code tools. Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and code quality tools. Experience writing automated unit tests using Vitest or similar frameworks. Familiarity with automated testing using Playwright , Postman , or similar tools. Experience working with modern React technologies such as TanStack Router/Query , Mantine UI , Zustand , or similar libraries. Understanding of secure coding practices involving sensitive customer information (PII/PCI). Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills. Self-driven with the ability to work independently while contributing effectively within Agile teams. Advanced English communication skills, both written and spoken. You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain scalable full-stack applications using TypeScript across React frontend and Node.js backend services. Build and enhance cloud-native, serverless applications using AWS services including Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and AWS CDK. Develop modern React user interfaces using established frontend patterns and component libraries. Design efficient DynamoDB data models using Single-Table Design and optimized access patterns. Develop secure and scalable RESTful APIs following OpenAPI specifications and implement schema validation using Zod. Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following established engineering standards and best practices. Create comprehensive unit tests while supporting automated API and end-to-end testing initiatives when needed. Participate in code reviews while ensuring high standards for quality, performance, maintainability, and security. Troubleshoot production issues, perform root-cause analysis, and continuously improve application reliability. Collaborate closely with software engineers, architects, product owners, and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle. Actively participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, daily standups, retrospectives, and backlog refinement. Take ownership of the solutions you build from implementation through deployment and production support. Nice to Have Experience with SQL Server. Experience with Amazon EventBridge. Experience with OpenSearch Serverless. Experience with Playwright. Experience working with Specification-Driven Development practices. Additional Information About Us We Are Engineered Different. At Applaudo, talented people design, build, and scale meaningful, AI-powered solutions that create real business impact. As an AI-native organization, we collaborate across design, development, cloud, data, and artificial intelligence to turn ideas into scalable products that transform how companies operate, make decisions, and grow. We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication . These define how we work, how we support one another, and how we hold ourselves accountable. Applaudo is a place for people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams they are proud to belong to. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Driller - Brazil
description: Job Summary The Driller is the onsite focal point for all well operations and Main Deck activities, under the overall control of the Rig Superintendent, and is responsible for Supervising onsite well operations activities, and for ensuring that the operation is completed safely & efficiently in accordance with the approved program and Company policies & procedures. Position title: Driller – Siem Helix Reports to: Toolpusher Job Summary The Driller is the onsite focal point for all well operations and Main Deck activities, under the overall control of the Rig Superintendent, and is responsible for Supervising onsite well operations activities, and for ensuring that the operation is completed safely & efficiently in accordance with the approved program and Company policies & procedures. The Driller will be conversant with all statutory requirements relating to Well Control and Well Intervention, with all personnel directly or indirectly involved with well operations conforming to the instructions issued by them. Duties & Responsibilities Coordinate, when needed, the Deck Supervisor on his supervision of the deck crew and 3rd Party/vendors on deck Liaise with the Tool Pusher and On Shift Client Representative regarding any changes to the approved well program and communicate these requested changes to all personnel working under their supervision. As delegate of the Rig Superintendent/ Tool Pusher, secure the well in emergency situations and always be aware of environmental aspects. Ensure that the Tool Pusher, Rig Superintendent and Client are advised of all current and/or changing conditions. Under instruction from the Tool Pusher they will conduct Emergency Disconnection Drill to ensure that all personnel are familiar with these operations and record the results in the Operations Daily report. First line is responsible for carrying out the well control and EDS procedures in situations of need emergency disconnect. Under instruction from the Tool pusher usher and or Rig Superintendent they will conduct Well Control Drills. Ensure that well control equipment is correctly maintained, installed and pressure tested. Take direction from the Tool Pusher in all Well Control Operations. Ensure that they have full understanding of the vessels Well Control Philosophy that includes the current HdB Policies on Well Control & Barriers. Request written dispensation from the tool pusher for any operations that cannot be carried out under the Helix Well Control & Barrier Policies. Conduct Pre-shift, TBT’s, TOFS, Daily drills, & weekly safety meetings with their crew. Ensure that Helix Health & Safety policies are communicated to and understood by all crew members. Ensure that all Supervisors communicate through toolbox meetings, all operational safety aspects of the 12-hour shift. In conjunction with the Tool pusher ensure vessel Well Operations Personnel are being trained to meet the company’s training matrix requirements. Ensure that the appropriate logs and records are maintained throughout their shift. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet daily to discuss previous 24 hours and ongoing operations. As part of the Offshore Management Team, meet as and when situations dictate, they are required. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix and Client safety & PPE policies by all personnel working on deck. Be responsible for the adherence to Helix & Statutory Lifting procedures and requirements by all personnel under his supervision. Record all relevant operational information (including but not limited to tool string and subsea equipment data, dimensions, hanging weights, overpulls etc.). They will ensure that this data is readily available in the doghouse throughout the project as required and officially recorded in their daily operational log. Be competent to operate the MPT and associated MPT systems. Directly supervise & record the opening and closing of the Intervention System and Subsea Tree. Ensure, on an ongoing basis, that all parties under their supervision have clear and effective lines of communication as required, and will ensure that operations do not commence until this is in place and confirmed. Ensure that operations are carried out in accordance with the latest instruction issued by the OMT with reference to the project documentation where required, and that all personnel under their supervision are clear as regards their role in the forward operation. Complete appraisal for all members of their crew & ensure that it is given to the Tool Pusher or Rig superintendent prior to their departure at the end of each trip. Instigate weekly DROPS inspections, ensuring actions are corrected, reported & logged in the DROPS register. Assist the vessel Maintenance team & Chief Engineer to maintain vessel equipment. Review and as required, perform all safety control duties as per rig´s specific HSE Case, Safety Case, HAZOP and JSAs. Perform, respecting any applicable license limitation and under supervision, similar responsibilities Tool Pusher for training, qualification and temporary coverage purposes. Perform, if required, the same duties as the Assistant Driller. QHSE: Following and complying with all the company's health, safety and environment policies, objectives/ targets and procedures Minimum Qualifications Requirements High school diploma or equivalent. Minimum 3 experience effectively working as a Driller or equivalent in well intervention projects. Qualification As per Helix training and competence directives. #J-18808-Ljbffr

É uma unidade especializada com vistas à promoção da saúde e prevenção de doenças e acidentes, além de identificar possíveis alterações relacionadas ou não com a atividade laboral e acadêmica, bem como possibilita a prevenção e a identificação precoce de eventuais patologias e riscos em potencial para a saúde visual e qualidade de vida. A unidade de saúde é preparada para o atendimento às mais diversas patologias do universo oftalmológico para a população da cidade do Rio de Janeiro, tais como: diagnóstico e tratamento dos distúrbios da motilidade ocular, visão binocular e anomalias associadas; realização de exames para correção refrativa e adaptação de lentes de contacto, bem como para análise da função visual; avaliação da condução nervosa do estímulo visual e das deficiências do campo visual; programação e utilização de terapêuticas específicas de recuperação e reeducação das perturbações da visão binocular e de subvisão; ações de sensibilização, programas de rastreio e prevenção no âmbito da promoção e educação para a saúde. realização de exames oftalmológicos diagnósticos, corretivos e periódicos com o objetivo, prioritariamente, a preservação da saúde, em função dos riscos existentes das patologias de base como hipertensão arterial sistêmica, diabetes mellitus, assim como oriundas do ambiente de trabalho e educação. Realizar a manutenção de microcomputadores. Instalar e configurar as impressoras locais e de rede. Instalar sistemas operacionais Microsoft e Software para escritório Microsoft Office. Configurar Internet e e-mail e Prestar suporte a usuários no uso da internet e outras atividades relacionadas ao suporte técnico de informática. A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental. Visão Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: Job Description ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história. A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes. Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país. E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras. Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades. Ter conhecimento de metodologias de Padrão Descritivo de Materiais e Serviços (PDM/PDS) de categorização de Compra (Categoria/Subcategoria de Compra ou Grupo de Mercadoria). Cadastro e manutenção de aprovadores vinculados aos centros de custo das áreas de negócio, garantindo a correta aplicação das alçadas de aprovação e aderência às políticas corporativas. Interagir com áreas usuárias para auxílio nos tipos de cadastro e documentos necessários. Responder chamados não atendidos nos níveis 0 e 1, garantindo o atendimento das metas estabelecidas em SLA. Monitorar os indicadores de desempenho dos processos (KPIs), confeccionar relatórios para apoio a gestão, sempre buscando a melhoria contínua. O Que Temos Para Você Vale Refeição/Alimentação; Vale Transporte/Estacionamento; Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de vida; Wellhub; Day Off Aniversário; Wellz (serviço de apoio psicossocial); Saber Online (plataforma interna de aprendizagem); Bônus anual. title: Executivo de Negócios | Sales Account Executive

Experiência em atendimento a clientes de grande porte, corporações com diferentes unidades de negócio, desenvolvimento de relacionamento executivo. Conhecimento em soluções para Engenharia, Desenvolvimento de Produto, Manutenção e Automação Industrial. Portfólio de soluções da sua unidade de negócios. Conhecimento de clientes/mercado/concorrência. A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970. A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão. A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação. Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental. Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber. Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros. O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS. O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo. Inclusão A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades. Missão Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental. Requirements and skills O que esperamos de você? Ensino superior completo em Administração, Tecnologia, Sistemas de Informação, Marketing ou áreas correlatas . Experiência como Product Owner ou em posições relacionadas à gestão de produtos digitais; Experiência com evolução de produtos, canais ou jornadas digitais; Vivência com discovery, priorização de backlog e gestão de roadmap; Capacidade de conectar visão de negócio, tecnologia e experiência do usuário; Experiência na atuação com squads e times multidisciplinares; Perfil analítico, estratégico e orientado a resultados; Excelente comunicação e capacidade de relacionamento com diferentes stakeholders; Facilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e de transformação digital. title: Staff Software Engineer (Marketing Platforms)
description: Nu is the leading digital bank in Latin America, serving 135 million customers across Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. Providing strong technical leadership: setting architectural direction, leading design reviews, evolving engineering standards and mentoring engineers and tech leads across multiple squads. title: B2B Sales Team Manager | Inside Sales
description: Do you want to be part of the largest healthcare platform in the world? We are Doctoralia, a Docplanner group company. We operate in 13 countries , serve more than 55 million patients, and process more than 17 million appointment bookings per month. Today, more than 2 million healthcare professionals are part of our base, and we've reached around 14 million patient reviews so far. Our mission is to help people live longer, healthier lives. To do this, we offer two complementary fronts: a marketplace, where patients can book and rate appointments at any time, and a SaaS system that helps practices optimize management, patient flow, and online appointments all available via web or app (iOS and Android). About The Role We're scaling up our B2B commercial operation, and we're looking for a manager who can take our sales management layer at Clinic Agenda and Feegow to the next level! This is a strategic, newly created role focused on driving predictable revenue, empowering our sales coordinators to lead effectively, and getting the operation ready to support the company's next phase of growth. Success in this role goes beyond achieving revenue targets. We are looking for someone who can build a scalable, data-driven sales organization that consistently delivers sustainable business growth. Key Responsibilities Leadership & People Development Lead, coach and develop sales coordinators, giving them clear goals, priorities, and individual development plans. Run regular and structured feedback, keeping a close eye on performance. Build a culture rooted in accountability, collaboration, and constant improvement. Partner with Talent Acquisition to attract, hire, and develop top commercial talent. Build and maintain a strong leadership structure capable of supporting the company's continued growth. Revenue Management & Sales Performance Drive revenue predictability through proactive pipeline management. Own the sales forecasting process, ensuring accurate projections and clear visibility for senior leadership. Monitor conversion rates, productivity, and overall sales performance metrics. Define sales targets, cascade business objectives, and ensure consistent execution across leadership and sales teams. Develop data-driven action plans to improve efficiency, conversion rates, and business results. Shaping Strategy and Scaling the Operation Ensure strong alignment between Pre-Sales and Sales teams to maximize conversion throughout the funnel. Spot bottlenecks and find ways to smooth out the sales journey. Keep pushing our commercial processes, tools, and practices forward. Drive operational discipline in CRM usage, sales processes, and performance tracking. Support automation, systems integration, and process optimization initiatives across the commercial operation. Cross-functional Collaboration Partner closely with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, and other business functions to maximize revenue generation and conversion. Support strategic decision-making through data analysis and performance insights. Represent the commercial organization in global meetings and prepare executive-level reports in English. What You’ll Need (Requirements) Proven experience directly leading sales coordinators or managers. Strong track record leading high-performing B2B sales organizations with ambitious revenue targets. Strong grasp of forecasting, pipeline management, conversion, and sales planning. Strong analytical and data-driven decision-making skills. Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM platforms. Advanced English communication skills for global meetings and executive reporting. Bachelor's degree required. Availability to work on-site in Rio de Janeiro. Nice to Have Experience at SaaS companies or in recurring-revenue business models. Background scaling commercial operations in high-growth environments. Hands-on experience building or scaling sales processes. Familiarity with sales automation and workflow optimization. A Few More Things Work schedule Monday to Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM Hybrid model (RJ): If you live in Rio de Janeiro or the metropolitan area, you'll work two days at our office in Santo Cristo/RJ and three days from home Hybrid model (CWB): If you live in Curitiba or the metropolitan area, you'll work two days at our office in downtown Curitiba and three days from home Remote model: You'll work 100% from home, but you're also always welcome at our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro. Our Benefits Overtime bank, taken as time off; Home Office Allowance (R$100); Meal/Food Voucher on a flexible iFood card (R$1 payroll deduction); Health Insurance (20% co-payment), Dental Insurance, and Group Life Insurance; Daycare Allowance (up to 5 years and 11 months old); StarBem (2 free psychologist sessions per month, 1 free nutritionist session per month); iFeel app, for emotional support; Wellhub for you and up to 3 dependents! Pet Plan, extending care to your furry friend as well; Birthday Day Off and Company Anniversary Day Off; Partnership Club, discounts at universities, language schools, and other institutions; Bereavement leave: 10 days in the event of the loss of a loved one, 2 days in the event of the loss of a pet; Maternity/paternity leave: 6 months for mothers and 30 days for fathers; Referral Program offering up to R$600 for referring new employees who stay with us for more than 6 months; Here at DOC, we value and celebrate diversity in all its forms. We are committed to attracting diverse talent, regardless of gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, age, or physical condition. We are committed to building an inclusive, welcoming team where every individual can shine and contribute their best. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: ESPECIALISTA SEGURANCA CIBERNÉTICA OT - LIDER TÉCNICO
description: Job type: Full-time employee Full-time employee Somos o Grupo Energisa!Com mais de cem anos de história, a Energisa é o maior grupo privado com controle 100% nacional do setor elétrico brasileiro. Nosso portfólio diversificado abrange distribuidoras, concessões de transmissão, geração de grande porte renovável, uma marca inovadora de soluções energéticas – a (re)energisa –, com geração distribuída por fonte renovável, comercialização de energia no mercado livre e serviços de valor agregado, além de uma central de serviços compartilhados, uma empresa de contact center e a fintech Voltz, a primeira do nosso setor no mercado de contas digitais. Recentemente, diversificamos nosso portfólio com a inclusão da distribuição de gás natural, através da aquisição da ES Gás.Transformamos, através de nossos mais de 17.000 colaboradores, energia em conforto e desenvolvimento para mais de 20 milhões de pessoas. Acreditamos na força da diversidade e da pluralidade para gerar inovação e atingir resultados incríveis. Aqui todos são muito bem-vindos!Quer fazer parte desta história? Confere se esta oportunidade tem match com o seu perfil e vem conosco participar esta jornada de seleção! Atuar como referência e líder técnico da disciplina de Segurança Cibernética OT no Grupo. Exercer a liderança técnica de dois profissionais, orientando prioridades, distribuindo demandas, revisando entregas e apoiando o desenvolvimento da equipe. Desdobrar a estratégia de Segurança Cibernética OT em roadmap, projetos, padrões técnicos, planos de ação e indicadores. Consolidar a visão de riscos, maturidade, resultados, desvios e necessidades de decisão para reporte periódico à gestão. Conduzir avaliações de riscos cibernéticos nos ambientes operacionais, considerando os possíveis impactos sobre: -segurança das pessoas; -confiabilidade e disponibilidade dos processos; -ativos e resultados do negócio. Definir e revisar arquiteturas de segurança para ambientes OT, incluindo segmentação de redes, zonas e conduítes, DMZ industrial, interconexões entre IT e OT e acesso remoto seguro. Estabelecer requisitos de segurança para novos projetos, modernizações, aquisições de tecnologias, fornecedores e integradores. Apoiar a evolução das capacidades de inventário, visibilidade, monitoramento, detecção e resposta a incidentes nos ambientes OT. Atuar em conjunto com o SOC na construção de casos de uso, procedimentos de monitoramento e playbooks específicos para ambientes industriais. Coordenar tecnicamente a identificação e o tratamento de vulnerabilidades, considerando criticidade, risco, disponibilidade e restrições dos ambientes operacionais. Acompanhar planos de remediação e evolução da maturidade junto às áreas responsáveis pelos ambientes operacionais. Definir indicadores de risco e desempenho que apoiem a priorização de iniciativas e a tomada de decisão pela gestão. Representar tecnicamente a disciplina de Segurança Cibernética OT em projetos, comitês, fóruns e discussões com lideranças, fornecedores e parceiros externos. Promover a integração entre Segurança Cibernética, Operação, Engenharia, Automação e Tecnologia da Informação, respeitando as responsabilidades de cada área. Formação superior em Engenharia, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Telecomunicações, Automação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência sólida em Segurança Cibernética OT, ICA ou sistemas de automação e controle industrial. Conhecimento de arquiteturas e tecnologias utilizadas em ambientes industriais e infraestruturas críticas. Experiência com segmentação de redes OT, DMZ industrial, firewalls, acessos remotos, monitoramento e proteção de ambientes críticos. Conhecimento de processos de inventário de ativos, gestão de vulnerabilidades, monitoramento, detecção e resposta a incidentes em ambientes OT. Experiência na condução de avaliações de riscos cibernéticos em ambientes operacionais. Capacidade de transformar riscos e necessidades técnicas em planos de ação, prioridades e recomendações para a gestão. Experiência na condução de projetos e iniciativas multidisciplinares. Capacidade de comunicação com públicos técnicos, áreas operacionais e lideranças. Perfil de liderança técnica, colaboração, influência e tomada de decisão. Gestão de riscos aplicada a ambientes industriais. Requisitos regulatórios e de segurança aplicáveis ao setor de energia e às infraestruturas críticas. Experiência no setor de Utilities ou outras infraestruturas críticas. Experiência em ambientes de Distribuição, Geração ou Transmissão de Energia. Participação em projetos de modernização, digitalização ou convergência entre ambientes IT e OT. Certificações em ISA/IEC 62443 ou equivalentes em Segurança Cibernética OT. As PESSOAS são nossa maior ENERGIA. Pensando em seu bem-estar, oferecemos um leque de benefícios. Da só uma conferida no que você terá: Vale alimentação ou Refeição para fazer as compras para sua casa ou comer no seu restaurante preferido Plano de saúde e odontológico para você e sua família Previdência privada para sua reserva financeira e investimentos Auxílio Creche para te apoiar nos primeiros anos com seus filhos Seguro de Vida, para dar mais tranquilidade a você e a quem você ama Participação nos lucros, como incentivo pelo seu trabalho e resultados Programas de qualidade de vida que garantem o bem-estar a prom… Programas de Bolsa de Estudo para te apoiar em qualificação profissional Gympass que te dá acesso a mais de 18 mil academias no Brasil Step 4: ENTREVISTA COM O RH 4 ENTREVISTA COM O RH Step 6: AVALIAÇÃO DE PERFIL 6 AVALIAÇÃO DE PERFIL Step 9: DOCUMENTAÇÃO 9 DOCUMENTAÇÃO Inovação, credibilidade e foco no cliente definem o nosso DNA. Buscamos incessantemente a qualidade no fornecimento de energia e a excelência no atendimento, garantindo conforto, segurança e bem-estar para os nossosconsumidores. Com mais de cem anos de atuação,estamos presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil: são 862 municípios nos estados daParaíba, Sergipe, Tocantins, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, Paraná, Acre e Rondônia. Atendemos cerca de 20milhões de pessoas, o equivalente a 10% da população brasileira. Somos ainda 100% brasileiros e estamosem constante expansão. Somos uma das principais empresas privadas do setor elétrico e estamos entre as melhores do país nos rankings da Agência Nacional de Energia Elétrica (Aneel) e da Associação Brasileira de Distribuidores de Energia Elétrica (Abradee). Mas a nossa empresa é feita de pessoas e, por isso, estamos sempre em busca de talentos com muita energia e dispostos a brilhar. Somos mais de 19mil colaboradores próprios e terceiros, todos ligados na mesma Missão, Visão e Valores. O nosso jeito de ser prioriza o lado humano com ética, respeito, transparência, segurança e compromisso com a comunidade, clientes e acionistas. Promovemos ainda projetos para estimular o uso consciente daenergia e apoiamos iniciativas sociais, esportivas e culturais nas regiões onde atuamos. Somos ligados em transformar energia em desenvolvimento porque acreditamos que juntos somos mais fortes. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Supervisor de Montagens e Manutenções de Campo
description: Liderar e executar, em campo, as atividades de montagem e manutenção mecânica e hidráulica dos equipamentos especiais da Natec — guindastes e A-Frames subsea, HPUs, cilindros e unidades hidráulicas — garantindo entregas técnicas seguras, dentro do prazo e em conformidade com normas, em operações onshore e embarcadas. O cargo existe para assegurar que a engenharia projetada em escritório se converta, em campo, em equipamento montado e mantido com confiabilidade, protegendo a operação do cliente e a reputação técnica da Natec junto ao mercado de óleo gás e naval. Missão do Cargo Liderar e executar, em campo, as atividades de montagem e manutenção mecânica e hidráulica dos equipamentos especiais da Natec — guindastes e A-Frames subsea, HPUs, cilindros e unidades hidráulicas — garantindo entregas técnicas seguras, dentro do prazo e em conformidade com normas, em operações onshore e embarcadas. O cargo existe para assegurar que a engenharia projetada em escritório se converta, em campo, em equipamento montado e mantido com confiabilidade, protegendo a operação do cliente e a reputação técnica da Natec junto ao mercado de óleo gás e naval. Atuar diretamente na execução de montagens e manutenções sempre que a operação exigir, servindo de referência técnica para a equipe. Planejar e coordenar rotinas de manutenção preventiva e corretiva de sistemas mecânicos e hidráulicos (redutores, rolamentos, HPUs, cilindros, bombas). Assegurar o cumprimento de normas de segurança do trabalho (NR-35, procedimentos offshore/HSE do cliente) e dos procedimentos de qualidade da Natec. Fazer a interface técnica entre engenharia, produção, cliente e embarcação, reportando avanço físico, desvios e riscos técnicos. Elaborar e validar relatórios técnicos de campo, RDOs e documentação de manutenção e montagem. Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de montagem e manutenção, propondo ajustes de procedimento e prevenção de falhas recorrentes. Atividades do Dia a Dia Supervisionar equipes de montagem e manutenção em campo e a bordo de embarcações. Executar montagens mecânicas e hidráulicas — cilindros, unidades hidráulicas, acionamentos, caixas de rolamento. Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva de redutores, rolamentos, HPUs, cilindros e bombas. Interpretar desenhos mecânicos e diagramas hidráulicos para orientar a execução da equipe. Diagnosticar falhas em sistemas hidráulicos de circuito aberto e fechado. Ajustar e calibrar bombas de pistão de vazão variável e válvulas proporcionais. Verificar aspectos elétricos básicos associados a válvulas e HPUs. Elaborar relatórios de campo, RDOs e registros de manutenção. Distribuir tarefas, prazos e prioridades entre os técnicos da equipe de campo. Zelar pelo cumprimento das normas de segurança (NR-35, procedimentos offshore) em toda a operação. Reportar à engenharia e à liderança da Natec o andamento das frentes de trabalho e os desvios técnicos identificados. Preparar-se e deslocar-se para embarques e trabalhos embarcados conforme a demanda operacional. Escolaridade e experiência Formação em Engenharia Mecânica completa, ou Técnico Mecânico/Hidráulico de nível sênior com trajetória comprovada equivalente. Registro no CREA desejável para o perfil de engenheiro. Experiência mínima de 5 a 8 anos em supervisão de trabalhos de campo em montagens e manutenções mecânicas e hidráulicas. Experiência em empresas ou operações offshore — desejável e valorizada. Experiência em trabalhos embarcados — desejável. Pacote Office e informática básica. Elaboração de relatórios técnicos e RDOs. Inglês intermediário a fluente — desejável. Certificações desejáveis: CBSP, T-HUET e NR-35. Experiência de campo Vivência comprovada em trabalhos de campo, preferencialmente em operações offshore. Disponibilidade para embarques e viagens a trabalho. Adaptabilidade a diferentes ambientes operacionais — plataformas, embarcações, canteiros e instalações do cliente. Resiliência à rotina de trabalho embarcado (escala, confinamento, condições climáticas adversas). Raciocínio lógico e independência para resolver problemas técnicos sem suporte imediato de escritório. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Dressing and Signage Design Manager
description: Description FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ ("FWWC2027") that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience. Department: Technical & Infrastructure Location: Brazil THE POSITION The Dressing and Signage Design Manager reports to the Senior Dressing and Signage Manager, serving as a key member of the FIFA27 Operations team in close collaboration with the Venue Management team and other stakeholders. The FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ requires outstanding look and feel project to be delivered in a seamless tournament experience. The Dressing and Signage Design Manager will be responsible for the overall management of the design workflow across the Dressing and Signage Project. The role is not principally a designer role, although the ability to design and artwork would be beneficial, the role will be to manage the workload of in-house and freelance design and artworking teams, and the workload for supplier-based artworking teams. The role will also be responsible for the sign-off of all event dressing and signage artworks prior to them entering the production phase. The successful candidate will work with the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers to develop a robust sign off procedure for the full product design, artwork and production processes using a combination of existing content management systems and in some cases custom solutions. They will be required to develop a comprehensive understanding of the brand for both tournaments and knowledge on how this can be translated successfully into elements suitable for dressing and signage. The role will be responsible for the design of all Dressing and Signage at the FIFA Women’s World Cup Brazil 2027™ including but not exclusive to the following workstream assets: Stadium Dressing Stadium Wayfinding Non-competition Venue Dressing Non-competition Venue Wayfinding Functional Area Signage and commodities Kit of Parts dressing Venue Concessions Fleet Buses The successful candidate will ensure all deliverables align with FIFA’s exacting standards while optimizing operational efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES To manage the design and artwork of all printed and digital materials required for the Dressing and Signage and function. To manage the creation of any mock-ups or visualisations that are required for the Dressing and Signage Function. To manage a network of in-house freelance designers and the workload for appointed supplier based design teams. To work with suppliers to create templates for all artworks, with all production considerations catered for such as required bleed etc. To work with other functional areas to create template visualisations of spaces across official sites. To be the initial and primary member of the artwork sign of team ensuring all artworks meet the design guidelines and principles for the respective competitions. Develop and manage a robust design and artworking process with the Dressing and Signage appointed suppliers, maximizing use of their content management systems where possible. Acting as the focal point for all Dressing and Signage design and artwork related queries and inputting into team meetings and reporting where necessary. Ability to possibly be relocated to a Host City for up to three months in to act as a Dressing and Signage Venue Manager at an allocated stadium during the event periods. YOUR PROFILE Strong experience in a Design management role in a fast paced environment, ideally with tangible experience in delivering dressing, signage, branding or look projects for events of a similar scale to FIFA World Cups, Olympic Games etc. An understanding of the technical aspects of print and production on dressing and signage projects advantageous (i.e. print/production methods, materials and the end purpose of designed assets). Experience in managing providers of services for world-class events or projects. Experience in the development and integration of Design Processes using content management systems. Significant stakeholder management experience across multiple organisations and departments. Bachelor’s or master’s degree in appropriate subject (or adequate training/vocational education) Design, Architecture, Project Management, or a related field. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio & Project) and planning software and online collaboration tools. The role will require extensive use of the appointed Dressing and Signage Supplier(s) project, content and scoping management systems so a readiness to learn new technology processes, systems and programs is essential. The role will require attending site visits and being away from home for periods of time, including on-site attendance during the tournament period. Right to work in Brazil. Bilingual – Brazilian Portuguese and English. Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro. #J-18808-Ljbffr

description: About Us At Félix, we're building the financial ecosystem for Latin immigrants in the U.S., starting with a revolution in remittances. This isn't just about the numbers; it's a testament to the trust our investors have in our vision and our team. We are all owners of Félix, driven by a bias for action and a true experimentation spirit to get shit done with urgency and focus. Joining Félix means you will be part of a team building a legacy, a company that will outlive us all. This is a rare opportunity to apply your skills to a deeply meaningful mission—serving a community that has been underserved for too long. We are a team that is fiercely loyal to each other, where radical transparency and constructive feedback are how we grow and push for excellence. We are bold, we care less about what others are doing, and more about creating sustainable value and a product that truly makes our users' lives better. We are building the future, today. About The Role As a Product Operations Specialist focused on Fraud Operations Processes, you will not just execute risk policies—you will be the architect of how our fraud operations scale. In a hyper‑growth fintech environment moving millions of dollars over WhatsApp, efficiency, speed, and accuracy are paramount. Your mission is to own, audit, and optimize our entire Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) library, bridging the gap between risk management, product capability, and operational execution. You will map out, fix and scale complex workflows, identify automation opportunities alongside Engineering and Product, and package high‑volume processes so they are ready to be seamlessly executed and ready to stop fraud while ensuring the legitimate user experience. Your ultimate goal is to build bulletproof, invisible guardrails that mitigate fraud while ensuring a frictionless user journey for legitimate customers recovering from false declines. Responsibilities SOP Architecture & Process Scalability: Maintain, continuously improve, and own the single source of truth for all live fraud operational processes. Standardize and document high‑volume workflows into clear, repeatable, step‑by‑step processes that can be executed consistently by any team member with minimal ramp‑up or oversight. Governance & Audit Cadence: Design and execute internal monitoring mechanisms, dashboards, and spot‑checks for core processes to ensure compliance, maintain high quality, and significantly improve user journey. Process Metrics & KPIs: Define, track, and optimize key health metrics for fraud workflows, including process adherence, operational throughput, and process quality. Automation & Tooling Improvement: Identify systemic operational bottlenecks, build data‑driven business cases for automation, and partner directly with Product Ops and Engineering to implement tools that eliminate manual overhead. Change Control & Strategic Alignment: Own versioning, sign‑off, and cross‑functional communication whenever a process evolves. Partner closely with Workforce Management (WFM), Quality and Training to ensure updates are instantly reflected in capacity models and training calibrations. User Experience Safeguarding: Ensure that while minimizing fraud risk, the user recovery journey is seamless, minimizing friction when legitimate users face false declines. Requirements Fraud/Payments Domain Expertise: Solid understanding of financial fraud risk vectors and known patterns. SOP & Process Engineering: Proven track record of mapping, documenting, and scaling complex operational workflows within high‑growth fintechs or tech environments. Automation & Outsourcing Mindset: Experience prepping operational processes for automation or external vendors, with a sharp eye for separating high‑judgment tasks from transactional ones. Data Fluency: Strong hands‑on experience querying data (SQL, BigQuery, Omni, or similar) to extract process metrics, build operational dashboards, and back up business cases with hard numbers. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional communication skills to align cross‑functional teams including Customer Operations, WFM, Product, Quality Assurance, and multiple stakeholders. Autonomy under Ambiguity: A true "owner" mentality with a strong bias for action, capable of navigating and creating structure out of unstructured startup environments. Language Proficiency: Professional fluency and advanced communication skills in English. Visit our Institutional Page About The Role Nubank is seeking a Staff Security Engineer to contribute in the Identity and Access Management security function across a financial technology organization serving over 100 million customers in Brazil, Mexico, and Colombia. This is a senior individual-contributor role with organizational-level technical influence, responsible for supporting a multi-year IAM security strategy, directing its execution across multiple engineering teams, and ensuring that identity and access controls meet the security, regulatory, and operational requirements of a globally operating financial institution. The Staff Security Engineer is expected to bring a demonstrated history of delivering consequential security programs — including programs that encountered setbacks — and the technical judgment that only sustained, hands‑on experience in the domain produces. Critically, this role requires a security engineering philosophy grounded in business enablement: the conviction that security done well accelerates what the organization can do, not merely protects it. This means rigorously distinguishing between controls that reduce real risk and those that create the appearance of compliance without reducing exposure, taking genuine ownership of outcomes rather than delegating accountability through policy, and continuously questioning inherited assumptions about what security measures are necessary, sufficient, or proportionate. What You’ll Be Responsible For Defining, communicating, and executing a multi‑year security strategy (especially in the IAM field) aligned with the organization's risk posture, regulatory obligations, and business objectives across multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. Lead organization‑wide authentication migrations that span heterogeneous surfaces — browser, operating system login, CLI tooling, and API‑level integrations — across thousands of employees, multiple device ecosystems, and distributed work environments, producing measurable outcomes: authentication success rates above 99%, material reductions in per‑authentication time, support exception rates below 1%, and return on investment within weeks of enforcement. Designing and maintaining the core identity infrastructure with the durability and operational discipline required at organizational scale: enterprise Identity Provider, PKI and X.509 certificate lifecycle automation, mutual TLS for service‑to‑service authentication, and credential management systems engineered to remain sound as the organization grows. Translating least‑privilege access from a principle into a measurable, organization‑wide program — with defined metrics, visible adoption curves, and accountability structures that allow Security and Engineering leadership to track and act on the organization's access risk posture over time. Designing and maintaining a security engineering framework — comprising technical mechanisms, policies, incentives, and assurance processes — that ensures security properties are durable, verifiable, and operationally sound, rather than dependent on individual vigilance or periodic audits. Leading technical incident response for identity and access security events, including critical vulnerabilities in remote access infrastructure, ensuring thorough investigation, documented root cause analysis, and structural improvements that reduce the likelihood and impact of recurrence. Designing and facilitating large‑scale preparedness exercises grounded in realistic attack paths — involving engineering, operations, and executive functions — to identify genuine gaps in IAM controls, not merely satisfy a compliance requirement. Providing technical mentorship and coaching to senior engineers; lead innovative projects with universities and actively collaborate in hiring and career decisions in order to maintain a high technical standard throughout the safety organization. Serving as the technical authority in engagements with Legal, Compliance, internal audit, and external regulators on matters related to identity, authentication, and access control. We Are Looking For a Person Who Has Must‑have +15 years of professional experience in security engineering, with a concentration in identity, authentication, or access management. Demonstrated track record of leading complex, multi‑year security programs from conception through measurable outcome — including programs that required navigating organizational obstacles, technical constraints, or material mid‑course corrections. Expert‑level knowledge of IAM and authentication protocols: OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, FIDO2/WebAuthn, mTLS, and Public Key Infrastructure (PKI). Proficiency in software engineering: ability to produce, review, and reason about production‑quality code in at least one general‑purpose programming language. Demonstrated ability to model identity‑related threat scenarios, assess attacker techniques relevant to the IAM surface, and design controls that remain effective under adversarial conditions. A demonstrable commitment to security as an organizational capability that enables business outcomes: a track record of solving real security problems, a disposition to challenge inherited security assumptions, and a clear pattern of distinguishing genuine risk reduction from security theater or responsibility transfer. Experience communicating technical risk assessments and strategic recommendations to senior non‑technical stakeholders, including executives and regulators. Nice‑to‑have Experience operating within a financial services institution or similarly regulated environment subject to multiple concurrent regulatory frameworks. Hands‑on experience administering or integrating with an enterprise Identity Provider at scale, particularly Okta, or Keycloak. Experience designing and enforcing security controls for third‑party, BPO, or partner environments without direct operational control of the partner's infrastructure. Experience leading organizational adoption of Zero Trust architecture, including authentication and authorization mechanisms for hybrid and multi‑cloud environments. Contributions to the broader security community — published research, conference presentations, open‑source tooling, or participation in standards bodies. About The Role The Digital Experience Platform (DXP) is Nubank’s AI-first platform ecosystem designed to radically compress our product development workflow from concept to production. Today, building "Magic App"-quality experiences in our Backend-Driven Content (BDC) stack takes ~49 working days and ~24 handoff-heavy steps - DXP exists to close this Creation Gap and Workflow Gap by making AI-native tooling the default way we design, build, and ship experiences. We are building four core products: DXP Studio (an AI-powered creation environment that turns Figma designs into production-ready BDC code), DXP Dictionary (the curated knowledge base that makes AI agents "Nu-aware"), DXP Spec Protocol (our vendor-agnostic abstraction layer), and DXP Workflow (an orchestration platform for hybrid human + AI agent teams across the product lifecycle). As a Staff Software Engineer - DXP , you will be the technical leader and multiplier for this initiative: shaping the architecture of an AI-native platform, driving critical decisions across the Figma-to-BDC pipeline and agent orchestration, and partnering closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to prove value and scale the platform company-wide. We’re looking for someone genuinely addicted to AI - who obsessively explores new models, agent frameworks, and AI-powered tools, and can turn that passion into leverage for thousands of Nubank engineers. Responsibilities Architect the DXP Studio pipeline: Design and lead the end-to-end architecture for the Figma → DXP Spec → BDC code generation flow, ensuring vendor-agnostic abstractions (DXP Spec Protocol), NuDS component fidelity, and production-ready output quality. Lead AI agent integration & orchestration: Define how AI agents (codegen, QA, design-mapping, etc.) are composed, executed, and supervised inside DXP; drive decisions on LLM provider abstraction, context-assembly strategies, MCP tool surfaces, and execution environments. Own the DXP Dictionary and knowledge architecture: Architect the knowledge base that turns generic AI into Nubank-aware agents - how NuDS specs, tokens, canonical patterns and domain knowledge are ingested, structured, and consumed by generation and validation pipelines. Drive cross-platform integration: Lead the technical integration model with NuDS (component catalog & tokens), BDC/Core (patterns & services), HPP (widget / homepage infrastructure), and App Excellence (observability & quality metrics), defining clear contracts that position DXP as an orchestrator on top of existing platforms. Establish quality-at-generation-time: Design automated quality enforcement for generated experiences - NuDS compliance, token correctness, accessibility rules, structural integrity, golden tests - so governance happens by default at generation time, not via manual post-hoc review. Set technical strategy and roadmap: Contribute to the 6-18 month technical strategy for DXP, translating strategic bets into executable plans, identifying architectural risks and trade-offs between POCs and long-term scalability. Multiply engineering excellence: Mentor engineers within DXP and partner teams (NuDS, BDC, Mobile Platform), lead design reviews and RFCs, and raise the bar for AI-augmented development practices across Nubank. Must Have Genuine obsession with AI tools and workflows - deep, hands-on, daily experience with LLMs, AI agents and modern AI-powered dev tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, custom agents, MCP servers); you are the person who has tried new tools before others even ask about them. Strong software architecture skills, with experience designing multi-component platform systems that integrate AI/LLM capabilities into production workflows. Deep understanding of design-to-code pipelines, design systems or component-driven UI development, ideally bridging design tooling (e.g., Figma) and code generation. Practical experience with AI/LLM integration in software products: prompt engineering, agent orchestration, context management, RAG architectures and/or MCP tool development. Proven ability to lead cross-functional technical initiatives involving multiple teams and stakeholders, driving alignment and delivery in ambiguous environments. Excellent communication skills, translating complex architectural decisions into clear narratives for Product, Design and senior leadership. Product-minded mindset, balancing technical excellence with pragmatic delivery - comfortable proving value via POCs before scaling platform capabilities. Experience with Nubank’s stack or similar patterns: BDC (Backend-Driven Content), and broader mobile/frontend ecosystems. Will be a Plus Experience with Flutter at the intersection of design systems and code generation. Hands-on experience building or integrating AI coding agents (e.g., Claude Code, Devin, Cursor) into team workflows. Familiarity with workflow orchestration platforms, agent farms or multi-agent systems. Understanding of analytical architectures, experimentation platforms, feature flags and progressive rollout strategies for generated experiences. Prior experience productizing internal developer tools or platforms that serve large engineering orgs. Contributions to open-source AI developer tools or active presence in the AI-for-developers community.
